doc.title: Adrian Cunningham interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 31, 2021

title: Club dates and why New York suits specialists
summary: He did party-band club dates using his commercial experience from Australian Idol, and praises New York's R&B, bebop and trad scenes where one can specialise.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: When you were trying to get known in the music scene, did you play gigs that you might not have anticipated playing: weddings and so forth and so on?

Yeah I did. The first couple of years I did some club dates with some kind of party bands and, which for me was fine because as I kind of touched upon earlier I did a lot of commercial work in Australia so I was no stranger to playing in horn sections. Like I used to play in the band for Australian Idol which is our equivalent to American Idol, so I’d done a lot of commercial work. I knew a lot of the pop tunes. So you know that was kind of a side of me that I had good experience of doing. I’ve kind of shed that since coming to New York because it’s really not what I wanted to do. So I used to do all the club dates and things like that. And just a little bit of a tangent what inspired me about New York is that no matter what you’re into there’s the best here. Because you know I love R&B, I love traditional jazz, I love bebop, I love — you know so I would go to all of these sessions, “Oh man there’s an R&B session here at the Village Underground and it’s unbelievable.” These guys play with Beyoncé, they play with Alicia Keys. So I’d go there on Monday, then I’d go to Small’s because you’d have the bebop guys who knew all of the heads and shout choruses of all the Bird tunes, it was like mind boggling. And here, the thing about growing up in Australia, you have to be a jack-of-all-trades to survive. But in New York you can just be one thing and you can be the best at that thing and you can go really deep on one thing because you can make a living doing that. You know it’s amazing like that.
